description: Distributed consensus protocols often persist optimization artifacts (Snapshots/Checkpoints) and safety metadata (Commit Indices, Voted Terms) in separate storage operations. If a crash occurs between these writes, or if the storage layer lacks atomicity, a node may recover with a "future" Snapshot and "past" Metadata.
trigger_condition: Restarting a node with a persisted Snapshot Index > Persisted Commit Index (or View/Epoch number).
test_template: 1.  **Setup**: Initialize the protocol's storage backend (mock or file-based).
